description: An e-commerce platform that allows creators to sell products, services, and memberships directly to consumers.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 for applications and developer access tokens generated via account settings for private use.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Gumroad account and generate access tokens or create applications self-serve.
api_notes: Covers products, sales, subscribers, licenses, and resource management via a JSON REST API.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Gumroad; community MCP status is unverified.
rationale: Gumroad provides a documented REST API with self-serve free credential generation via account settings and OAuth.
